entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello? I'd like to make a return for an item I bought a couple of months ago.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It was a helmet I bought as a gift.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order from about 65 days ago for the Apex Trail helmet. To process this correctly, can I ask what the specific issue is?
There's no issue with the helmet itself. The box is still unopened. It was a gift, and my partner just didn't like the color. We were hoping for something that matched their bike better.

I completely understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the policy here... Yes, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can definitely approve this return for a full refund for you. We want to make sure every rider has gear they love for both style and safety.

That's excellent news, thank you. Since I'm going through the process of sending it back, would it be possible to get a 15% discount code for a future purchase? I'll be ordering the replacement helmet from you as well.

I'm glad I could get that return approved for you. While I'm not able to provide a discount code for this type of return, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely covered by us, so there will be no cost to you to send the helmet back.
Okay, free return shipping is fair. I appreciate that. So how do I get the label?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Just attach it to the original box and drop it at a shipping center. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Perfect. That works for me. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today at VeloFit?
Alright. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling.
